description: Tool definitions for the Claude Messages API calls n8n makes to the brain. Paste the relevant tool(s) into the n8n HTTP Request node's body under `tools`, matching brain/system_prompt.md. force tool_choice so Claude always responds structurally rather than in free text.

tools.name: submit_route_plan
tools.description: Submit the plan for which market registry routes to attempt this run, with the non-sensitive parameters each one needs. Called once per profile variant if comparing multiple vehicle/coverage scenarios in one request.

profile_label.description: Short label distinguishing this plan if multiple profile variants were requested, e.g. '2026 Chevrolet Equinox' vs '2025 Chevrolet Equinox'.

registry_id.description: Must match an id in registry/market_registry.json.

params.description: planning_safe fields only, named per schema/intake_schema.json, e.g. { "vehicle_identity.model_year": 2026, "coverage_configuration.third_party_liability_limit": 2000000 }.

reason.description: Why this route was selected for this profile.
e.g. duplicate_rate_source of another planned route, product_scope mismatch, still unresolved in the registry.

notes.description: Anything the user should know about this plan before it runs.

tools.name: submit_comparison
tools.description: Submit the normalized, deduplicated comparison across all results collected for a run.

results.description: Each item mirrors schema/quote_result_schema.json#result, enriched with dedup notes.

annual_premium.description: null if no premium was disclosed at this step — never guessed.

deductible_match.description: 'matches_benchmark', a concrete stated difference (e.g. '$1,000 collision/comprehensive deductible vs. $500 benchmark'), or 'not_disclosed'.

additional_coverage.description: Coverage included beyond the benchmark (e.g. 'roadside assistance', 'accident forgiveness'). Empty array if none observed — never omit to mean 'none'.

variance_from_benchmark.description: Every other concrete difference from the benchmark, one short statement each. Empty array only if coverage was confirmed to match exactly.

applied.description: Discounts explicitly confirmed as applied (e.g. 'winter tires'). Empty array if none confirmed.

disclosed.description: false if the route never disclosed discount info at this step — distinct from disclosing zero discounts applied.

gaps.description: Plain statements of what remains unresolved/blocked/incomplete, per docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md style — no inflation, no silent drops.

summary_text.description: Human-readable summary for the one person this system serves.

tools.name: flag_new_field
tools.description: Raise an anomaly: input contained something that looks sensitive or unrecognized rather than a clean planning_safe field. Never process the suspected value — only describe what was observed.

observed_at.description: Where in the input this was seen, e.g. 'route plan request, field vehicle_identity.owner_name'.

description.description: What made this look sensitive or unrecognized — never repeat the actual value.
